name: lazywait-codepush-legacy-proxy
description: Transparent reverse proxy that keeps the retired Azure CodePush hostname answering. Pipes every request to CODEPUSH_UPSTREAM and stamps X-Legacy-Host: azure so the upstream access log can tell fielded binaries apart from new ones.

scripts.deploy: npm run zip && az webapp deploy --name codepushapp --resource-group lazywait-code-push --src-path ./legacy-proxy.zip --type zip
